UC-820.en: On Windows, Clauseo stops Claude's file tools and its usual file commands from opening or changing another matter's files. It can't stop everything yet: a program Claude writes and runs, or a command it tucks inside another command, can still reach them; ChatGPT's commands can read other matters' folders; and, until an update closes it, Claude can see the names and sizes of the folders and files of other matters kept in the same folder as this one. For matters that must stay strictly apart, use a Mac.
UC-820.note: Provisional and wider than the launch build: narrowed to what still gets through the host's command scan once the host sends that list (orchestrator, 16 Nov). Also changes when the folder-listing gap closes.
